answer: To resist sybils every agent locks an escalating bond to anchor its key to a unique root published in a shared haven. A bridge to another identity requires both to lock matching collateral jointly slashed on correlated activity. First identity pays 10 units the k-th pays 10+2*(k-1). A 500-farm locks over 250000 while honest agents pay once and reclaim after clean epochs. Random bridge audits burn the cluster bond on failure.
